text: When it comes to making college affordable, whether it's two-year or four-year, one of the things that I did as president was we were sending $60 billion to banks and lenders as middlemen for the student loan program, even though the loans were guaranteed
speaker: OBAMA

text: there was no risk for the banks or the lenders, but they were taking billions out of the system
speaker: OBAMA

text: we said, "Why not cut out the middleman?"
speaker: OBAMA

text: as a consequence, what we've been able to do is to provide millions more students assistance, lower or keep low interest rates on student loans
speaker: OBAMA
